evaluator: Codex assistant (semantic evaluation subagent; not an independent student review)
method: Offline manual reading of every saved prompt, actual supplied context, source-label map, and unedited answer against the frozen six-question key. No evaluator model calls. Atomic distinct factual propositions are counted once; repeated wording and restated questions are not additional claims. Epistemic inability-to-answer statements are not factual answer claims, but independent assertions about document topics, procedures, source attribution, or deadlines are counted. Partial support does not credit a whole factual proposition. A has N/A context faithfulness. Valid citation syntax is separate from citation-supported grounding, and omission of an essential gold fact makes accuracy false even when all emitted claims are faithful. Exact refusal formatting is scored separately from whether abstention was appropriate; Q4 requires clarification. Retrieval and final coverage are recomputed from frozen source offsets using evidence_span_coverage. This is an evaluation of saved historical documents, not current legal advice.
